scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: vp i && ln -sf $T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env .env && ln -sf $T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/infra/relay/.env infra/relay/.env && node apps/web/scripts/warm-dep-cache.ts

scripts.name: Setup Worktree (Windows)
scripts.command: vp i && New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path .env -Target "$env:T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT\.env" -Force && New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path "infra\relay\.env" -Target "$env:T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT\infra\relay\.env" -Force && node apps\web\scripts\warm-dep-cache.ts

scripts.name: Sync Upstream Workflows
scripts.command: git fetch upstream; git checkout main; git merge upstream/main --no-edit; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'Merge conflicts: resolve them on main, then push main yourself.' } else { $changed = git diff --name-only ORIG_HEAD HEAD -- .github/workflows; if ($changed) { git checkout ORIG_HEAD -- .github/workflows/release-fork.yml .github/workflows/sync-fork-main.yml; git commit --amend --no-edit; Write-Host 'Restored fork workflow files into the merge commit.' }; git push origin main; git push origin main:personal/main }
